summary: Zamboanga City 1st District representative with 174 principal-authored bills. Authored overtime-hour limits, mandated staff housing for large enterprises, higher barangay-worker benefits and travel-tax abolition; co-authored a wage increase and mental-health-in-workplace measures.
caveat: Economic evidence only; no social, civil-liberties or institutions evidence found. No votes reviewed.

economic.rationale: Authored overtime limits and employer-provided staff housing (-3), higher barangay-worker benefits (-1); against travel-tax abolition (+2) and co-authored mental-health drug VAT exemption (-1). Labor-protective lean with mixed tax signals.
